Attention-deﬁcit/hyperactivity disorder(ADHD) is a common problem, affecting 7-9% of children(American Psychiatric Association 2000).
The defining features of ADHD are inattention, hyperactivity and impulsivity.
Pharmacological treatments are widely used with behavioral treatments in ADHD.
However it's origin is not clarified.
So pharmacological effects are limited and its adverse effects are common.
Data from family practice physicians and internists show that acupuncture is one of the most frequently recommended CAM therapies.
There is evidence of acupuncture for effectiveness/efficacy on postoperative nausea and vomiting, stress/pain, substance abuse, enuresis.
One of the advantages of acupuncture is that the incidence of adverse effects is substantially lower than that of many drugs used for the same conditions.

Acupuncture is reported to be a relatively simple, inexpensive and safe treatment compared to other conventional interventions, is acceptable to Chinese patients and has been widely used to improve severity of the core symptoms in patients with ADHD.
The aim of this study is to assess acupuncture effectiveness on 80 ADHD participants by using clinical acupuncture points.

1. Needling details 0.20mm×30mm Stainless steel acupuncture For each time, Using 13 acupunture points[(GV20)*1, (EX-HN1)*4, (LI4)*2, (LI11)*2, (SP6)*2, (LR3)*2] Acupuncture maintaining for 20min. 2. Treatment regimen 2 times/week * 6weeks 3. Co-interventions In the first 3rd weeks visit and sixth weeks visit, an education for their parents will be conducted. 4. Practitioner background One with 6 yrs regular oriental medical college education, having OMD(oriental medical doctor) license, knowing well about this study and acupuncture safety education. 5. Control intervention The control group will be 6 weeks waiting list without additional ADHD treatment. In the first 3rd weeks visit and sixth weeks visit, an education for their parents will be conducted with ADHD symptom improvement check. If CGI-I score ≧6, participant stops waiting and drops out (as same on acupuncture treatment group for study ethical issues). After waiting endpoint, participants will be given acupuncture treatment for 6 weeks as same.
